overall_comments: Strong Round 2 retrofit. Trap (daily-vs-weekly scope confusion) is grounded in Carpenter & Moser CGI counting-and-multiplicative-reasoning AND Thompson & Saldanha rate-as-state, with three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A: drills 'multiply by days'; B: forces PER day/week/year sentence frame; C: drills PER means RATE). Coach Cara's prediction refrain 'PER day, PER week, PER YEAR — rate × time = TOTAL!' anchors both hook and exit_routine — children chant it 3x. INVENT-AND-COMPARE step (action.steps[5]) has two pairs share Station C scaling rules and class debates accuracy, citing Thompson & Saldanha — clears the Level 4 mathematical_authenticity bar for invent-and-compare. Materials path is everyday (charts, counters, number lines); puppets explicitly OPTIONAL with paper-bag/picture substitutes. Worksheet varies practice format (independent paper vs station-based) while still mapping each part to a named success criterion. Bridges from Lesson 2 data to Lesson 4 reflections and Lesson 5 capstone explicitly in expanded_walkthrough rationale.
